description: Paid: 0.001 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.001 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Small metric summarizing public AI-provider status pages (Statuspage API; currently GitHub; full list at /v1/sources): level, one reason, per-provider indicator, asOf and sources with attribution, terms_url and not_affiliated. openai/cursor keys return null until 2026-11-12 (deprecated). Not affiliated with any source. Cached up to 60 s. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.
